seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: SoS unofficial primary returns: Lofgren 54.9%, Shane Lewis (R) 29.3%, Luis Arreguin (D) 12.9%, Chris Demers (NPP) 2.9%. The AP reports that Lewis advanced. Ballotpedia pages disagree on the primary field. Lofgren's start year on the county board differs between sources (1980 or 1981). The BenitoLink Q&A gives Lewis's age as 54 and says he has lived in Santa Clara County for 30 years. Lewis education not found. Voteview gives Lofgren's birth year as 1947 (not a primary source). Ballot designations not found.
